nodes.summary: Let $J \subseteq \mathbb{R}$ be an open set containing $[0, 1]$, and let $u, v : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be functions that are differentiable at every point of $J$ and whose derivatives $u'$ and $v'$ are differentiable at every point of $J$. If $-u''(x) \le -v''(x)$ for every $x \in (0, 1)$, $u(0) \le v(0)$ and $u(1) \le v(1)$, then $u(x) \le v(x)$ for every $x \in [0, 1]$.
nodes.title: Comparison principle for the Dirichlet problem on $(0, 1)$

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a finite-dimensional real normed space and let $f : \mathbb{R} \times E \to E$ be continuous. Then for every $t_0 \in \mathbb{R}$ and $x_0 \in E$ there are $\varepsilon > 0$ and a function $x : \mathbb{R} \to E$ with $x(t_0) = x_0$ such that, for every $t \in (t_0 - \varepsilon, t_0 + \varepsilon)$, $x$ is differentiable at $t$ with $x'(t) = f(t, x(t))$.
nodes.title: Cauchy–Peano existence theorem

nodes.summary: Let $y : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be differentiable at every $t > 0$ with $y'(t) = -y(t)^3$, continuous at $0$ within $[0, \infty)$, and such that $y(0) = 1$. Then $y(t) \sqrt{t} \to 1/\sqrt{2}$ as $t \to \infty$.
nodes.title: Decay rate of solutions of $y' = -y^3$

nodes.title: Dirichlet eigenvalues of $-y'' = \lambda y$ on $(0, \pi)$

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real Banach space, let $A : E \to E$ be a bounded linear operator, let $b : \mathbb{R} \to E$ be continuous, and let $t_0 \in \mathbb{R}$ and $x_0 \in E$. Write $e^{sA}$ for the operator exponential and define $x : \mathbb{R} \to E$ by $x(t) = e^{(t - t_0)A} x_0 + \int_{t_0}^{t} e^{(t - s)A} b(s)\, ds$. nodes.title: Duhamel's formula (variation of constants)

nodes.summary: Let $\omega > 0$ be a real number that is not an integer, and let $g : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be continuous and $2\pi$-periodic. Then the equation $u'' + \omega^2 u = g$ has exactly one twice continuously differentiable solution $u : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ that is $2\pi$-periodic, and every twice continuously differentiable solution $u : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ of this equation is bounded.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
